To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
semi-atomicity of flexible transactions can be preserved by imposing restrictions on the commit dependencies among subtransactions.

(1) the semi-atomic commitment order of the global transaction can be derived from the commit dependencies; and (2) the semi-atomicy of a flexible transaction can be ensured by restricting the transaction to the class of flexible transactions whose commit dependencies are acyclic.
the semi-atomic execution of flexible transactions is guaranteed by the use of the commit dependencies and by the enforcement of certain restrictions upon the transaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a flexible transaction model that is robust to the autonomous actions of the local sites.
the development of a flexible transaction model that is both robust and flexible.

the development of a framework that enables a local site to autonomously maintain the consistency of a flexible global transaction, and that allows local sites to cooperate in the commitment order of a global transaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
semi-atomicity is the most appropriate atomicity criterion for flexible transactions.
semi-atomicity is a more flexible criterion for global transaction execution.
semi-atomicity of a global transaction is ensured by the local sites, and local autonomy is ensured by global transactions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a class of flexible transactions that can be executed in a multidatabase system in an autonomous fashion without violating the semi-atomic property.

the semi-atomic flexible transactions are a superset of the atomic flexible transactions, and the semi-atomic global transactions can be executed at a local site without any knowledge of the other sites.
semi-atomicity provides the flexibility to execute global transactions without sacrificing consistency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
semi-atomicity can be preserved for flexible transactions, and this is a desirable property for global transactions to have.
semi-atomicity can be maintained for flexible transactions, even in the presence of autonomous local sites, by controlling the commitment order of subtransactions.
semi-atomicity of flexible transactions can be preserved without sacrificing local site autonomy.
